Endeavor is to maintain EBITDA at similar levels in the short run while remaining open to growth investments.

Utilization reached a high of 91.8%, driven by AI-enabled delivery efficiencies.
Macro environment remains dynamic with elongated client decision cycles.

timeline.summary: Sonata Software achieved AWS Migration and Modernization Competency status.
Sonata Software announced the appointment of Rajsekhar Datta Roy as CEO effective May 9, 2026, following the conclusion of MD & CEO Samir Dhir's term.
Sonata Software reported Q4 standalone revenue of ₹410.71 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹4.15 per share.
Sonata Software released its Q4 FY26 investor presentation detailing strategic growth in cloud and data services.
Rajan Raheja, Suman Raheja, Akshay Raheja, and Viren Raheja declared no encumbrance on Sonata Software shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI regulations.
Sonata Software appointed Rajsekhar Datta Roy as CEO and reported an AI-led order book of $49 million for FY26.
Analysts / Investors call scheduled for Friday, 6th November 2026, 2:00-3:00 p.m. IST.
